name: Peanut Butter Cheesecake
assumptions: Yield estimated from standard 20cm cheesecake tin size and typical 8-slice division for similar BBC Good Food recipes.
Total active preparation time summed from steps: ~10 min crust, ~15 min filling, ~10 min topping, ~10 min miscellaneous (soaking, chilling not counted as prep).
Peanut Cookies classified as containing wheat (standard biscuit base).
Peanut Butter and Peanut Brittle classified as containing peanuts.
All dairy ingredients (butter, ricotta, milk, cream) confirm dairy and milk allergen.
No eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, soy, or sesame explicitly listed or typically present.
instructions:
Oil and line a 20cm round loose- bottomed cake tin with cling film, making it as smooth as possible. Melt the butter in a pan. Crush the biscuits by bashing them in a bag with a rolling pin, then stir them into the butter until very well coated. Press the mixture firmly into the base of the tin and chill.
Soak the gelatine in water while you make the filling. Tip the ricotta into a bowl, then beat in the peanut butter and syrup. Ricotta has a slightly grainy texture so blitz until smooth with a stick blender for a smoother texture if you prefer.
Take the soaked gelatine from the water and squeeze dry. Put it into a pan with the milk and heat very gently until the gelatine dissolves. Beat into the peanut mixture, then tip onto the biscuit base. Chill until set.
To freeze, leave in the tin and as soon as it is solid, cover the surface with cling film, then wrap the tin with cling film and foil.
To defrost, thaw in the fridge overnight.
To serve, carefully remove from the tin. Whisk the cream with the sugar until it holds its shape, then spread on top of the cheesecake and scatter with the peanut brittle.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard unsalted butter; all used in crust.

ingredients.name: Peanut Cookies
ingredients.assumptions: Typical peanut butter sandwich cookies (e.g. Nutter Butter style); entire amount crushed for base.

ingredients.name: Gelatine Leafs
ingredients.assumptions: 5 standard gelatine leaves (approx 2 g each); negligible nutrition, all dissolved into filling.

ingredients.name: Ricotta
ingredients.assumptions: Whole-milk ricotta cheese; entire 500 g used in filling, as-is.

ingredients.name: Peanut Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard smooth peanut butter; entire amount incorporated into filling.

ingredients.name: Golden Syrup
ingredients.assumptions: Golden syrup (light treacle); entire quantity beaten into filling.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Cow's milk (semi-skimmed); entire 150 ml used to dissolve gelatine.

ingredients.name: Double Cream
ingredients.assumptions: Heavy/double cream; entire amount whipped for topping.

ingredients.name: Light Brown Soft Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 level US tablespoons light brown soft sugar (≈25 g); all used to sweeten whipped cream.

ingredients.name: Peanut Brittle
ingredients.assumptions: Crushed peanut brittle for scattering on top; plausible 30 g garnish amount estimated from typical dessert decoration and recipe context.
